title: Samsung DW80 — Smart Install entry
description: Enter Smart Install (AS) for automatic/manual component inspection.

steps.title: Power on — set 17 h timer
steps.body: Power on dishwasher and set timer for 17 hours.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Power on dishwasher and set timer for 17 hours.

steps.title: Enter Smart Install
steps.body: Press Hi-Temp Wash key for at least 7 seconds. Display shows AS when Smart Install is active.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Power On → 17 h timer → Hi-Temp Wash 7 s.
